description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Reyes Beverage Group is hiring an Application Developer - VIP to develop and support solutions using the Microsoft technology stack. The role also supports third-party software, maintains documentation and processes, and works with end users and other developers.
Application Developer building and supporting Microsoft-stack solutions, maintaining Windows software, and gathering user requirements

Responsibilities:
• Develop and support existing and new solutions implemented within the Microsoft technology stack
• Install, support, and maintain third party software on a windows environment
• Produce and maintain system and end user documentation
• Provide and support continuous improvement on processes
• Engage with end users on support matters, enhancement requests and gathering requirements for larger projects
• Provide mentorship with other developers on the team
• Ability to travel within the U.S. (approximately 10-15% of the time)
• Other projects or duties as assigned

Requirements:
• Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, or Management Information Systems or related field and 1 to 2 years of related experience or High School Diploma/General Education Degree (GED) and 3 to 5 plus years of specific experience
• Experience of 1 to 2 years with programming software applications and enhancements
• Experience of 1 to 2 years with .Net / C# programming for both batch and web platforms a must
• Experience with Microsoft SQL Server programming language and PowerShell

Preferred:
• Bachelor's Degree
• Experience with Microsoft SQL Server administration, Microsoft IIS administration, Microsoft VB scripting is a plus
• Javascript development within web forms
• Experience integrating with REST or SOAP API's
• Basic understanding of JSON or XML formatting
• Secure FTP and encryption/decryption processing a plus
• Experience with Cloud DevOps or Microsoft Azure, developing in workflow systems, and IBM DB2 environment a plus
